name: Gath-hepher
line: Gath-hepher was a city on the border of Zebulun's land, and it is known as the hometown of the prophet Jonah son of Amittai.

moments.title: On Zebulun's Border
moments.text: When the land was divided, the border of Zebulun's territory crossed eastward to Gath-hepher. It was one of the places marking the edge of the tribe's inheritance.
